name: Tinmorry
summary: Budget filament label distributed largely through Amazon and its own storefronts, emphasising metallic and silk specialty finishes alongside standard PLA and PETG. No legal entity or factory was identified; third-party reviews repeatedly flag batch-to-batch consistency problems.

product_lines.name: Rapid PLA
product_lines.notes: Marketed as the standard PLA line and rated for fast printing; no TDS confirms a distinct high-flow rheology, so both ids are listed with pla as the safe base.

product_lines.name: Metallic PLA
product_lines.notes: Metallic-pigment PLA; pigment effect only, no evidence of metal powder loading, so pla-metal is not asserted.

product_lines.name: Metallic / Galaxy / Marble / Sparkly / Matte PETG, PETG Glowing in the Dark
product_lines.notes: Cosmetic-additive PETG variants; catalog has no matte/glow PETG ids, chemistry is petg.

product_lines.name: TPU Reinforced Filament (glass fiber)
product_lines.notes: Glass-fiber-filled TPU — an unusual semi-rigid elastomer composite; tpu-gf id is provisional.

product_lines.name: PA Reinforced Filament
product_lines.notes: Reinforced nylon; neither the PA type nor the fiber type is stated in the listing, so no pa6-cf/pa6-gf/pa12-cf grade id can be assigned.

product_lines.name: PET Reinforced Filament
product_lines.notes: Reinforced PET; filler type unspecified, so pet-cf is not asserted.

product_lines.name: PP Reinforced Filament
product_lines.notes: Reinforced polypropylene; filler type unspecified, so pp-gf is not asserted.

product_lines.name: PC Reinforced Filament
product_lines.notes: Reinforced polycarbonate; filler type unspecified, so pc-gf (provisional) is not asserted.

additional_notes: An alternate storefront exists at https://tinmorry.net/. Headquarters and manufacturing location are not disclosed by any source found; China origin is presumed from the distribution pattern and product design and is unverified. Rated Tier C by filamentcheatsheet at $14-28/kg, with polarised reviews — reports of catastrophic PETG blob failures alongside praise for good batches, plus customer-service disputes. Build plates: none found, so makes_plates is left unset. No OEM relationship to any brand in the verified-OEM file was found; the actual contract producer is unknown.

provenance.conflicts: No legal entity, HQ or manufacturing site was confirmed by any source; headquarters_country and manufacturing_countries are presumption from distribution pattern only and should be treated as unverified. Reviews disagree sharply on quality, ranging from total print failures to positive reports.
